rooms.name: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] The First Waystone
rooms.blurb: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] A mossed stone at the road's edge, cut lines waiting under the green.

rooms.name: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] The First Middle
rooms.blurb: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] The grey stands off the width of a spoken thing, and no further.

rooms.name: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] The Second Waystone
rooms.blurb: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] Rain-softened lettering, half a stretch still legible.

rooms.name: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] The Long Deep Middle
rooms.blurb: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] Sound goes small here. Something older than a wisp keeps pace.

rooms.name: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] The Third Waystone
rooms.blurb: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] The last stone before the water. Beyond it, the bridge.

rooms.name: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] The Span
rooms.blurb: [T2-PLACEHOLDER] A broken bridge, a waystation, and something still walking its rounds.
